attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 752590)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/A_Plague_Tale:_Innocence
Fandom (aplaguetale.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://aplaguetale.fandom.com/wiki/A_Plague_Tale:_Innocence
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). 16 of 35 Steam achievements are hidden, with API names ACH_01 to ACH_16; their unlock rates fall steadily (82% down to 44%), which suggests they mark story progress in order, so they were split four to a part by API number. Whether each one matches a single game chapter was not checked. "Knights!" (Complete all chapters) was put in the last story part. StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0; its Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents subpages are linked but none exists, so nothing was used. aplaguetale.fandom.com answers the API, with about 41 linked pages (characters and places, no chapter pages); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
